claims: Eid prayer (Salat al-Eid) is typically held on the first day of Eid.
Eid prayer (Salat al-Eid) is typically held shortly after sunrise.
Eid prayer times usually range between 7:00 AM and 10:00 AM local time.
Most mosques offer multiple sessions for Eid prayer.
Eid prayer is performed in local mosques or designated large open spaces (Musalla or Eidgah).
Eid prayer schedules are released after the moon sighting.
Eid prayer cannot be done immediately after Fajr.
